main_text.l: dum esse censemus, & iis præsertim, unde
bonæ prolis ipes est. Cæterum eorum,
chirurgia confirmari par est. Quæ autem
ad id conferunt pharmaca cogendi uim
rum duplex genus statuimus. Nam alia
uberrima extat sylua apud ueteres & re-
centiores medicos. Præ cæteris autem ad
motum, cum intus assumptum mire com-
spongiosum quendam lapidem, qui in Hil
debergæ fabulis frequens reperitur ad idé [?]
foris admotum cum oui albumine, masti-
æstimant: eo quod fracta ossa mirifice co-
tis experti fumus. Huc accedunt intus assu

page.notes: Catchword "menda," stands alone at the lower right and is kept out of the text. The last line ends without a printed hyphen; the catchword suggests "assumenda", so "assu" is kept as read. "idé" has an uncertain accent, marked [?]. Long s is rendered as plain s throughout. Line 2 "ijs" is rendered "iis", and "Hil" in "qui in Hil" is kept as printed. Print shows light foxing and show-through from the reverse, which is not transcribed.
